name: Calyx
description: The calyx: a ring of sepals cupping the bud they were built to protect.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 2%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50.0% 0.0%, 62.9% 32.2%, 97.6% 34.5%, 70.9% 56.8%, 79.4% 90.5%, 50.0% 72.0%, 20.6% 90.5%, 29.1% 56.8%, 2.4% 34.5%, 37.1% 32.2%); clip-path: polygon(50.0% 0.0%, 62.9% 32.2%, 97.6% 34.5%, 70.9% 56.8%, 79.4% 90.5%, 50.0% 72.0%, 20.6% 90.5%, 29.1% 56.8%, 2.4% 34.5%, 37.1% 32.2%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 34%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
